description: Implementation of QuicClientSessionCache class managing QUIC session caching, including session validation, insertion, lookup, and management of session states.

classes.name: QuicClientSessionCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of QUIC client sessions, supporting insertion, lookup, and expiration handling.

classes.name: QuicResumptionState
classes.description: Represents the state needed to resume a QUIC session, including TLS session, transport parameters, application state, and token.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Internal class representing a cache entry holding multiple sessions, parameters, application state, and token.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new session into the cache, or updates existing entries if matching parameters.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves a session state for a given server ID if valid and not expired.

methods.name: ClearEarlyData
methods.description: Clears early data from cached sessions for a specific server.

methods.name: OnNewTokenReceived
methods.description: Stores a new token associated with a server ID.

methods.name: RemoveExpiredEntries
methods.description: Removes expired sessions from the cache based on current time.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the cache.

methods.name: CreateAndInsertEntry
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry with session, parameters, and application state.
